title: Live progress of a run (runs/<runDir>/progress.json)
description: Rewritten atomically while a run is in progress; poll it until state is done or failed. report.json stays the only final result. Timeline entries have exactly the report.json timeline[] shape. See docs/API.md.

state.description: waiting_for_user = real mode (CLI only): Chrome is being attached or the human is still clearing captcha/login and has not pressed Enter; nothing is recorded yet, url is null; planning_task = no goal was given (POST /api/runs without goal): the task is being worked out from the start page, goal is still null (step 0 may already be in timeline); running = acting step by step; analyzing = detectors/axe/judge; fixing = generating and applying a fix (POST /api/runs/<runDir>/fix); rerunning = the fixed copy is re-audited (see rerunDir); done = report.json is already written; failed = see error. (The run list GET /api/runs also shows a state unknown, which is never written to progress.json: it means this file is corrupt.)

step.description: i of the last recorded step (= timeline[-1].i); null before the first step

maxSteps.description: Step limit of the planner (the start step 0 is not counted)

timeline.description: Steps so far. findingIds is [] until the run is done; the final ids are in report.json.

rerunDir.description: Set when state becomes rerunning: the rerun's own runDir, which already has its own progress.json. Kept in the done/failed that follow; null before a rerun

error.description: state failed: one sentence to show the user. null otherwise

url.description: The audit's start URL (= report.json meta.url). null until known (real mode: after step 0) and in a fix's progress (read report.json). Optional: absent in files written before plan 17 P2

goal.description: The audit's task (= report.json meta.goal). null while planning_task and in a fix's progress. Optional, like url
